authorial_core.setting: A closed ferry-terminal customs booth at night.
authorial_core.event: A covert meeting realized as a connected two-hand passport exchange.
visual_priorities: The portrait-guided operative is the focal presence while both hands stay connected through the same booklet.
Head-to-mid-thigh crop and an upright dark doorway make the observer's physical position legible.
A dark booth contains a readable face and booklet, with a cool rear edge light separated from the warm frontal fill.
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic espionage photograph of a covert meeting at its decisive instant. The focal human operative is guided by the supplied portrait: use the supplied portrait for face and hair appearance guidance, preserving the softly rounded facial proportions, dark eyes, jaw-length dark brown bob and wispy fringe. Inside a closed ferry-terminal customs booth at night, she is caught completing a discreet passport exchange. Her charcoal wool coat hangs open over an ivory blouse. Her body is turned toward a courier at screen right, while her head turns back toward the corridor on camera left; alert eyes and a slightly parted mouth carry quiet personal magnetism. At her waist, her right hand and the courier's left hand hold opposite ends of one burgundy passport booklet, the two grips and the entire booklet visibly connected. The courier's shoulder occupies the right foreground, with only the arm needed for the exchange entering the central space. The capture camera looks obliquely into the booth from the corridor at her chest height, with its sensor level and the vertical door jambs upright. Use a cowboy shot that includes her whole head and body down to mid-thigh. A softly blurred near door edge covers part of the courier's shoulder but leaves her face and both grips clear. Two side jambs and the overhead lintel make a dark frame within the photographic frame around her. Low-key lighting leaves most of the booth in darkness. A small weak warm desk light from front-left reveals her face and the booklet, while cool ferry light from behind on camera right traces a narrow bright rim along the right edge of her bob and coat shoulder. Beyond the booth, a shut inspection shutter and a distant strip of water through terminal glass make the hurried meeting feel temporary. Natural skin texture, restrained film grain, and focused detail on the operative and the shared booklet give the moment a photographed, inhabited quality.
